sampling.seed_note: API seed was not sent; API-side sampling variance remains.

format_attribution.note: Post-hoc diagnostic only: the official judge result is unchanged. Each fenced failure was re-judged after extracting the fenced JSON, replaying executed tool calls on the deterministic fixture, and applying the same judge. This separates content correctness from output-contract compliance.

api.environment: local client -> DashScope compatible endpoint; network latency included

cost.api_actual_charge: not available from API response; calculate from console bill

scope.note: The 45 diagnostic tasks are not cross-template held-out. The result supports same-family instance behavior only, not general coding ability.

conclusion: 严格固定输出契约下，本地 7B SFT 在 45 个受限任务上显著超过 API baseline（效应量 +8.9pp，Holm p=5.866e-11，95% CI [+4.7, +13.3]pp）。失败归因显示 40/41 次 API 失败是最终答案被 fenced JSON 包裹；离线去除 fence 后 40/40 通过同一 judge，内容级 API≈99.8% vs SFT≈99.8%（post-hoc McNemar p=1）。因此这是输出契约可靠性的优势，不能写成任务内容推理优势。
